prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather. ONE complete 1536x1024 literary-room SAME-ACTIVITY mother.
IMAGE 1 is root-approved EMPTY target weather/time ROOM, authoritative for the whole camera, room geometry and LIGHT. IMAGE 2 is root-approved APRICOT SAME-ACTIVITY MOTHER, authoritative for exact character identity, real current pose/expression, clothing/proportions, hand/object relationships, image position and actual support. Use ONLY these two images. Do not draw a new activity or use a generic chat face/body.
LOCK camera/perspective/window divisions and ALL major furniture/materials to image 1: desk/chair, shelves/plants/books/pictures, original ceramic lamp/round table/cup/flowers, right bench/plaid pillows/knitted throw, rug/floor/foreground depth. Keep image 2's precise head/gaze/shoulders/torso/back/pelvis, elbows/wrists/palms/fingers, skirt/legs and complete shoes in original pose/location/size. No zoom, crop, head enlargement, lensward lean, body shift or furniture move. Real hip/cushion, palm/object and shoe/floor supports remain. Complete hair/head, hands, hem, ankles and both shoes stay in frame.
REPAINT COHERENT LIGHT over the ENTIRE person, skin/hair/clothes/shoes, paper/book/plane where present, cushion/contact receiver, wood and floor to image 1's weather. Old sunny bars, sharp noon skin hot patches and bright gold rims are NOT identity: remove and re-light them, especially knees/wrists/shirt shoulders; do NOT merely recolor their old shape. Match material reflections, exposure, local lamp falloff and softened contact. No CSS/global filter, pasted sunny person, split day-night or new fixture. Indoor clothes/paper/floor stay dry.
Fine original youthful anime identity in rich painted room. Hair strands/cheek strands, eyelids/lashes, iris and pupils separate and readable. No fused fringe/black eyes, mature glamour or chibi. No UI/text/labels/badges/cards/bubbles/trails/arrows/halos/watermark/signature/split view. No new hand prop. Preserve the actual distinctive psychology already visible in image 2; rain is not automatically sadness.

UIKA 三角初华: source short warm-blonde bob and VIOLET/PURPLE eyes, plain white short sleeve tee, taupe-gray long skirt, white ankle socks and full black/white canvas sneakers. Distinguish blonde/skin/white cloth/paper values. Keep uncrossed skirt drape with two separate continuous lower legs/ankles and two independently floor-supported sneakers; no tucked foot/new crossed-knee ridge.
RESUME: preserve actual soft recognition in violet gaze and small mouth curve, original head inclination. Blue hardcover remains V-OPEN at its approved source angle ON LAP, one hand keeps it supported/at the retained page, OTHER complete palm rests on actual cushion beside hip. Root approved the visible page retention: do not force book fully closed or invent a separately displayed bookmark finger. Quiet continuation, no greeting performance/new prop.
MIST / OVERCAST DAY: image 1 dry silver-gray cloudy DAYTIME and softly veiled lake/town/mountains, diffuse cool-neutral window light with modest original lamp warmth. Not rain/night. No hard sunny rectangle/rim/hot spot on skin, cloth, paper, floor. Skin and white paper retain dimensional soft shading, not chalky blue.
